payload.title: The byte-for-byte mirror between the gate's Closes-trailer regex and the kernel's was deleted, and nothing pins the part that is still typed twice: the trailer frame and the F-NNN, F-AUTO-V and DEBT forms
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/plan_origin.py:65-72 (CLOSES_TRAILER_RE; its comment says the F and DEBT forms are mirrored verbatim)
tools/gates/commit-msg-validator.ts:114-116 (CLOSES_TRAILER_REGEX: the same frame and the same F-NNN, F-AUTO-V and DEBT alternatives)
aria-kernel/tests/test_registry_finding_id_four_digits.py:51-57 (the refused values leave out F- and DEBT- values and whitespace)
aria-kernel/tests/test_registry_finding_id_four_digits.py:62-76 (the trailer tests match only the registry-id group of the table)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md one owner per concept and the architectural-solution hierarchy tier 3: a copy that cannot move to an owner is held to its twin by a test that turns red when one side changes
payload.notes: Close condition: The trailer frame and the F-NNN, F-AUTO-V and DEBT alternatives have one source per language that the gate and the kernel both build from, as the registry id already does, or one table of trailer lines (accepted and refused: F-001, F-AUTO-V1.2-X, DEBT-2026-05-08-001, a trailing space, a missing #) is evaluated by both tools. A test that edits one side's F or DEBT form turns red.
